tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: WASD to move the submarine around
Q and E to rotate the submarine

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: The Herta auto stabilises itself, but in the event
of an impact, the stabilisation core will take
some time to regain control.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Press 1, 2, 3 and 4 to toggle weapon ports
The UI on the top left shows ammunition
The red and blue lights show the fire states.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: When red, it responds to your left mouse button
When blue, it responds to your right mouse button
When neither, it means the weapon is inactive.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Like any submarine, once armour integrity
on any side reaches 0 integrity, a fatal
hull breach is to be expected.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: However, this specific Herta class submarine
uses an experimental reactive hull failsafe
that prevents a hull breach on armour failure.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: This means that the submarine could survive
any amount of damage, but once the failsafe kicks
in, any subsequent damage will prove to be fatal.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Finally, if you ever need to revisit the combat
system tutorial, press the ? button at the top
right to bring it up again.

tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: Thank you for using HertaOS!
This covers all there is to know about
the combat system. Have a very safe day.

startup_choice.title: Tutorial
lines: The Herta combat computer boots to life.
"Defensive and offensive systems active."
"Would you like a tour of the systems?"

skip_tutorial.title: Tutorial
lines: The controls of the Herta are all too familiar to you.
Luckily, you already know that you can press the ? button
at the top right to bring up the tutorial again!
